2607.00975.title: TRCGL-Net: A Long-Tailed Multi-Label Chest X-Ray Classification Framework with Generative Data Augmentation and Label Co-Occurrence Modeling
2607.00975.paper_summary: Chest X-ray multi-label classification is a core task in intelligent medical imaging diagnosis. However, real clinical data often exhibit extreme long-tailed distributions, leading to degraded performance on rare diseases in tail classes. This issue is not only driven by data scarcity but also by two intrinsic factors:1) attenuation of tail-class lesion representations under complex anatomical backgrounds, and 2) dominance of head classes in modeling label co-occurrence relationships. To address these challenges, we propose TRCGL-Net. First, a learnable text-guided conditional diffusion model is employed to generate high-quality tail-class chest X-ray image samples under disease semantic constraints, improving data diversity and realism of rare disease patterns while alleviating class imbalance and preserving pathology-consistent semantics.Second, a channel reweighting mechanism is introduced to perform feature recalibration by emphasizing disease-relevant feature channels, thereby improving feature discriminability under long-tailed distributions.A class-aware attention mechanism is further applied to generate class-specific attention maps, enabling the model to localize disease-relevant regions and focus on fine-grained lesion areas.Finally, a graph convolution network based on label co occurrence is introduced to establish an information propagation mechanism among categories. Experiments on the PadChest dataset show that the proposed method achieves a tail-class mAP of 0.4904, an overall mAP of 0.4408, and an mAUC of 0.8989, outperforming state-of-the-art methods. TRCGL-Net effectively improves recognition performance for rare diseases under long-tailed distributions and mitigates the impact of extreme class imbalance in chest X-ray multi-label classification.
2607.00975.paper_summary_zh: 胸部 X 光多標籤分類是智能醫療影像診斷中的核心任務。<lb/>然而，真實臨床數據往往表現出極端長尾分佈，導致在尾部類別中的罕見疾病性能下降。<lb/>這個問題不僅是由於數據稀缺驅動的，還有兩個內在因素：1）在複雜解剖背景下，尾部類別病變表現的衰減，和 2）在建模標籤共現關係中，頭部類別的主導地位。<lb/>為了應對這些挑戰，我們提出了 TRCGL-Net。<lb/>首先，使用可學習的文本引導條件擴散模型，在疾病語義約束下生成高質量的尾部類別胸部 X 光影像樣本，改善罕見疾病模式的數據多樣性和真實性，同時減輕類別不平衡並保持病理一致的語義。<lb/>其次，引入了一個通道重加權機制，通過強調與疾病相關的特徵通道來進行特徵重新校準，從而改善在長尾分佈下的特徵區分能力。<lb/>進一步應用了一個類別感知注意機制，以生成類別特定的注意圖，使用戶能夠定位與疾病相關的區域並專注於細微的病變區域。<lb/>最後，基於標籤共現的圖卷積網絡被引入，以建立類別之間的信息傳播機制。<lb/>在 PadChest 數據集上的實驗顯示，所提出的方法達到了 0.4904 的尾部類別 mAP、0.4408 的整體 mAP 和 0.8989 的 mAUC，超越了最先進的方法。<lb/>TRCGL-Net 有效改善了在長尾分佈下對罕見疾病的識別性能，並減輕了胸部 X 光多標籤分類中極端類別不平衡的影響。
